The Real Object Law says every element is a real physical object; "a little flat" is the same failure at a smaller size, and his word now forbids the excuse that a little is acceptable. The plus sign is the counter-example in his own words: it is good, it stays, and it should open up — the control that works is the one that is alive and does something. Depth is not decoration on top of the page; it is what makes the page alive at all.
